summary_1line: Parasara teaches that actions inevitably bear fruit, urging self‑control, renunciation, and righteousness while warning that knowingly committed sin brings unavoidable suffering.

image_candidates.scene_text: A charioteer steering a chariot-body with reins of knowledge while the horses of the senses strain toward worldly objects.
An uncolored cloth being washed clean beside a black‑dyed cloth that cannot be purified.
A sinner whose distorted vision mistakes his fragile body for the radiant soul within.
